text:
elaine: proposing a short-lived circuit-breaker for v2->v1 fallthroughs. idea is to limit automatic fallback when error rate or latency spikes exceed thresholds so we don’t silently route a flood of traffic to v1. thoughts?

sanjay: curious — is this for safety or to protect v1 capacity?

elaine: both. safety (unexpected semantic changes) and capacity. we had a week where v2 degraded and v1 got overloaded. automatic fallback made it worse.

mari: +1. need an observable signal set though. what do we measure? error count, p50/p95 latency, and downstream 429s?

jacob: agree. also add token-per-request delta — if v2 suddenly returns much longer responses, cost explodes on v1 fallback.

elaine: draft thresholds:
```yaml
circuit_breaker:
  errors_per_minute: 100
  p95_latency_ms: 1200
  token_delta_pct: 50
  cool_down_s: 300
  max_fallback_rate: 0.2 # fraction of requests allowed to fall back
```

mari: looks reasonable as a starting point. need to add an override for customer-shrinkwrap (enterprise contracts) and a console kill-switch.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/v2-circuit-breaker -> staging at 2026-03-21T02:10Z :rocket:

elaine: good call on overrides. also want a canary mode: page ops when breaker fires in prod more than 3 times in 10m.

sanjay: UX question: in the console, do we surface this as a toggle under "routing policies" and show live metrics + recent triggers?

console-team: yep, we can add a panel: "compat circuit-breaker" with last 24h triggers, thresholds, and manual revert. should show per-customer and global views.

jacob: telemetry - we need a new event type `cb_trigger` with fields: reason, metric_value, affected_route, fallback_rate, causal_trace_id. keeps logs small but queryable.

elaine: agree on event. add `prompt_set_id` when available so evals folks can correlate.

mari: how does this interact with our current rollout policy? e.g., canary->gradual->all? if breaker trips during canary, we should auto-hold rollout, not fall back global.

elaine: plan: breaker scope = {global, customer, route}. for canaries scope=canary-only. when scoped breaker triggers during rollout, halt rollout and notify rollout owner instead of full fallback.

ops-bot: note saved: rollout-halt-on-cb-trigger (docs/ops/playbooks).

jacob: for quotas: when fallback_rate > 0, we should apply soft rate-limiting to keep v1 within reserved capacity. maybe a token-bucket per-customer.

mari: implement conservative defaults: max_fallback_rate=0.05 for new tenants, 0.2 for established. allow enterprise override.

elaine: testing plan: staging test harness to simulate v2 latency/error patterns and assert breaker trips and halts rollout. add unit tests for config parsing + UI integration tests for console toggle.

sanjay: timeline?

elaine: prototype in staging this week, internal beta next week, opt-in for a subset of customers then GA after two weeks of stable metrics.

console-team: we'll prep UI mocks by EOD and attach in the thread.

mari: can we also add a regression alert if breaker becomes the primary routing decision for >50% of traffic over 24h? that's a signal our model changes broke compatibility.

elaine: yes — add alert `compat-breaker-regression` -> page on high severity.

deploy-bot: staging deploy complete: feature/v2-circuit-breaker @ 2026-03-21T02:14Z :white_check_mark:

elaine: thanks all. I'll update the design doc + create a follow-up PR for telemetry fields and console mocks. tagging @console-team for the UI bits :eyes:

jacob: thanks — putting a TODO to add `cb_trigger` to our kafka schema registry.

mari: once PRs land, lets run a DR test where we induce v2 errors and observe rollout halt + telemetry.

elaine: agreed. closing loop after DR test. 

console-team: will post mocks in #design in 30m. :thumbsup:
